caption: The drawing features a cream or beige background with two large curving green vines spreading horizontally across the central area. These vines have multiple offshoots bearing light green leaves and yellow and brown buds, as well as pink and cream-colored flowers with green accents. There are five birds in the composition: two birds in the air above the vines with wings spread, and three birds on the ground below the vines. The birds are detailed with brown, blue, and yellow feathers, and black tails and legs. At the bottom edge of the drawing is a horizontal band designed to look like grass, depicted with short vertical green lines. The artist's name, "EUGENE A. FORJET," appears in small text at the bottom right corner.
title: Curtain
